triga-budapest

Graphics work in the same language, with the same types, as everything else here. This is the box-geometry module of the scene behind the rendered frames on the home page.

Source: examples/triga-budapest

src/box_geom.fab#

One file of a multi-file package: it refers to siblings that are not shown here.

import from "triga:math" math

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lit box geometry — 24 vertices (4 per face × 6 faces), 36 indices.
#
# Each face has its own 4 vertices so normals are flat per-face.
# Vertex stride: 9 f32 (36 bytes) = position(3) + normal(3) + color(3).
#
# Face order: +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@ private
fn append_face(
    list<f32> payload,
    f32 x1, f32 y1, f32 z1,
    f32 x2, f32 y2, f32 z2,
    f32 x3, f32 y3, f32 z3,
    f32 x4, f32 y4, f32 z4,
    f32 nx, f32 ny, f32 nz,
    f32 r, f32 g, f32 b
) → list<f32> {
    payload.append(x1)
    payload.append(y1)
    payload.append(z1)
    payload.append(nx)
    payload.append(ny)
    payload.append(nz)
    payload.append(r)
    payload.append(g)
    payload.append(b)

    payload.append(x2)
    payload.append(y2)
    payload.append(z2)
    payload.append(nx)
    payload.append(ny)
    payload.append(nz)
    payload.append(r)
    payload.append(g)
    payload.append(b)

    payload.append(x3)
    payload.append(y3)
    payload.append(z3)
    payload.append(nx)
    payload.append(ny)
    payload.append(nz)
    payload.append(r)
    payload.append(g)
    payload.append(b)

    payload.append(x4)
    payload.append(y4)
    payload.append(z4)
    payload.append(nx)
    payload.append(ny)
    payload.append(nz)
    payload.append(r)
    payload.append(g)
    payload.append(b)

    return payload
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# box_indices — 36 indices for 24 lit box vertices.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
fn box_indices() → list<u32> {
    var list<u32> idx ← empty
    var int face ← 0
    while face < 6 {
        const u32 base ← ((face * 4) ↦ u32)
        idx.append(base)
        idx.append(base + 1)
        idx.append(base + 2)
        idx.append(base)
        idx.append(base + 2)
        idx.append(base + 3)
        face ← face + 1
    }
    return idx
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# box_vertex_payload — interleaved [px,py,pz, nx,ny,nz, cr,cg,cb, …]
# for 24 lit vertices.  This is the only payload the host needs.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
fn box_vertex_payload(ref math.Box<3> bounds, f32 r, f32 g, f32 b) → list<f32> ∪ none {
    if math.box_validum(bounds) ≡ false then return null

    const f32 x1 ← math.x(bounds.minima)
    const f32 y1 ← math.y(bounds.minima)
    const f32 z1 ← math.z(bounds.minima)
    const f32 x2 ← math.x(bounds.maxima)
    const f32 y2 ← math.y(bounds.maxima)
    const f32 z2 ← math.z(bounds.maxima)

    var list<f32> p ← empty

    # +X face (right) — normal (1,0,0)
    p ← append_face(p, x2, y1, z1, x2, y2, z1, x2, y2, z2, x2, y1, z2, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, r, g, b)

    # -X face (left) — normal (-1,0,0)
    p ← append_face(p, x1, y1, z2, x1, y2, z2, x1, y2, z1, x1, y1, z1, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0, r, g, b)

    # +Y face (top) — normal (0,1,0)
    p ← append_face(p, x1, y2, z1, x2, y2, z1, x2, y2, z2, x1, y2, z2, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, r, g, b)

    # -Y face (bottom) — normal (0,-1,0)
    p ← append_face(p, x1, y1, z2, x2, y1, z2, x2, y1, z1, x1, y1, z1, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0, r, g, b)

    # +Z face (front/pest) — normal (0,0,1)
    p ← append_face(p, x1, y1, z2, x2, y1, z2, x2, y2, z2, x1, y2, z2, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, r, g, b)

    # -Z face (back/buda) — normal (0,0,-1)
    p ← append_face(p, x2, y1, z1, x1, y1, z1, x1, y2, z1, x2, y2, z1, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0, r, g, b)

    return p
}
